title: Flag server errors
prompt: The on-call team wants every request marked as a server error or not. Write `solve(api_requests)` so it returns a DataFrame with `request_id`, `service` and `is_server_error` for every request.
rules: `is_server_error` is `true` when `status_code` is 500 or more, and `false` otherwise. A 4xx code is the caller's mistake, not a server error.
Return one row per request, duplicates included, with the columns in the order `request_id`, `service`, `is_server_error`.
`is_server_error` is a boolean column. On a day with no requests, return an empty DataFrame with these three columns.
hints: `api_requests.rdd.map(...)` can turn each row into a tuple: `(r["request_id"], r["service"], ...)`.
`toDF` can't guess types from an empty RDD. Give it the types instead of just names: `toDF("request_id string, service string, is_server_error boolean")`.
